title: 20 डिग्री
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape literary editorial illustration for a humorous Hindi personal blog post about winter called 20 degrees. Main scene: a generic young Indian male cartoon character, fully clothed in loose pyjamas and a T-shirt, towel draped over shoulders, pauses just outside a simple tiled bathroom shower. Three-quarter back view, face barely seen and deliberately simplified, not a likeness of any real person. His hesitant slightly hunched posture and one cautiously extended hand communicate thirty seconds of negotiation before entering cold water. Showerhead on the wall with a few cold blue drops, no steam. Warm pale winter morning sunlight falls through an adjacent open doorway; a friendly street dog is comfortably curled up on a folded burlap sack nearby, quietly ignoring the boy. Understated affectionate deadpan humour, familiar modest Indian home, nostalgic but contemporary. Painterly gouache/storybook illustration, textured paper, soft detailed brushwork, warm amber sunlight versus cool teal bathroom shadows, restrained earthy palette, in the same literary family as hand-painted illustrations of a disappointed ghost outside a mosquito net and personified Time in an Excel cell. Composition wide approximately 3:2 with main action visible in the central area for a social preview crop. No nudity, no realistic portrait or identifiable person, no words, no caption, no watermark, no logos. Avoid excessive visual clutter, no collage or multiple panels.
